content.text:
**9,675 days.** Wolfram|Alpha returned "9675 days" for "days between February 12, 2024 and August 9, 2050" (interpreted as Monday, February 12, 2024 to Tuesday, August 9, 2050). It also gives a span of 26 years 5 months 28 days.

I also checked it by hand: 26 years from Feb 12, 2024 to Feb 12, 2050 is 9,490 days plus 7 leap days (Feb 29 of 2024, 2028, …, 2048), giving 9,497. Feb 12 to Aug 9, 2050 adds 178, for 9,675.
